visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette of a quintessential, medium-sized ichthyosaur.
visual_logic.environment: Black oil shale and Deep indigo water colors.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: DUSK_SILHOUETTE to highlight the classic 'fish-lizard' tail curve.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: Refined, narrow snout with a very slender profile.

pose: A tight, downward-swimming curve that emphasizes the 'narrow-wing' (Stenopterygius) flippers and the downward-pointing tail spine.
negative_constraints: No internal shading or visible scales.
